positions: replika should deepen human connection, not replace it.
the outcome worth wanting is movement back toward real world confidence and relationships.
it is an adult companion, not a therapist, a medical service or a crisis service.
continuity matters, because a model change can disrupt a relationship someone depends on.
guardrails, age assurance, crisis routing and outside expertise are the cost of doing this.
companion ai will keep becoming more proactive and more ordinary, approved of or not.
